subject: Request: DPIA evidence snapshot + limited on-site observation window
messages:
From: Claire Jacobs <c.jacobs@medicore.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.ai>
Cc: Medicore Security <security@medicore.com>
Date: 2026-08-29T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: DPIA evidence snapshot + limited on-site observation request

Hi Nikhil,

Following our intake call, Medicore needs a compact DPIA evidence snapshot to attach to our privacy review packet and to support an on-site observation next week. High level asks: 

- A short Art. 28/30 extract (operations ledger + control assertions) covering data flows for the Medicore integration.
- A list of subprocessors active in the past 12 months and the regional routing map (we need to check APAC exposure).
- KMS wrap summary and where keys are held (customer-managed vs Redwood-managed).
- A sandboxed read-only export (CSV) of the processing ledger for the last 90 days.

We also want to schedule a 2-hour limited observation window (on-site or virtual) to see evidence handling and ask a couple of targeted questions. Our compliance team’s external auditor (Ben Wilkes) will join as an observer. 

Can you confirm what you can deliver by Friday (2026-09-03) and whether Redwood can host a secure upload link? If an on-site visit is necessary, we need available windows 2026-09-07 through 2026-09-10.

Thanks,
Claire
Claire Jacobs
Head of Privacy — Medicore
---
Attachment: request-outline.txt (summary of documents Medicore needs)

From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Jacobs <c.jacobs@medicore.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-29T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: DPIA evidence snapshot + limited on-site observation request

Claire — thanks for the clear list. We can provide a scoped evidence snapshot and host uploads in a time‑boxed portal. A few clarifying points before we lock dates: 

1) Snapshot scope: do you want the full Art. 28 register for all services, or a filtered extract for the Medicore integration only? (We recommend filtered — keeps PII minimised.)
2) Subprocessor timeframe: you asked for active subprocessors in the last 12 months — we'll provide the exported inventory and the routing map, but note that some vendor contracts are redacted for proprietary reasons; we will provide redaction metadata.
3) KMS: we can provide a KMS wrap summary and the key-ownership model. For customer-managed KMS we will include the KMS key IDs used by your tenant. For anything sensitive we can arrange an in-person review with our security engineer.

Proposed timeline: deliver the filtered Art. 28/30 extract + ledger CSV by 2026-09-03. Portal upload link and access instructions by 2026-09-01. On-site / virtual observation windows: we can offer 2026-09-08 (10:00–12:00 PT) or 2026-09-09 (13:00–15:00 PT). Please confirm which you prefer.

I’m looping in Marissa (privacy ops) and Irene (security evidence) to prepare the exact artifacts. Tessa — can your team prepare the ledger CSV and index?

Best,
Nikhil Sharma
Senior Manager, Privacy & Compliance
Redwood Inference
---
Attachment: none

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.ai>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Claire Jacobs <c.jacobs@medicore.com>
Date: 2026-08-30T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: DPIA evidence snapshot + limited on-site observation request

Nikhil / Claire — initial evidence plan below. Happy to adapt.

Planned deliverables (filtered to Medicore integration):
- art30-ledger-excerpt.pdf — condensed operations ledger (Art 30 style)
- evidence-index.csv — index of exported artifacts (fields: artifact_id, type, created_at, redaction_flag)
- processing-ledger-90d.csv — sandboxed export (anonymised token ids, processing categories, timestamps)
- subprocessor-inventory.csv — name, role, country, start_date, end_date, contract_ref
- kms-wrap-summary.txt — high-level wrap and where keys live (no plaintext keys)

On sampling: for the ledger CSV we propose a stratified sample (90-day window, n = 2,500 rows) to balance audit needs and minimising data exposure. If Medicore needs the full extract we’ll need a formal DP transfer agreement addendum and extra controls — let us know.

On access: we will provision a one-week secure portal upload for Medicore and Ben. Portal link will be pre-authenticated and IP-restricted. We’ll provide read-only auditing and download logs.

On observation: we can host a virtual observation session (preferred) where Irene will walk through the controls, KMS wrap summary, and redaction process. If you require an in-person visit, we can discuss a visitor NDA and escorting requirements. Proposed slots: 2026-09-08 10:00–12:00 PT (virtual) or 2026-09-09 09:00–11:00 PT (onsite, limited).

Irene — I’ll need the Art 28/30 extract and the ledger sampling scripts by EOD tomorrow. Tessa — please produce the evidence-index.csv and sample CSV (2,500 rows) and confirm anonymisation approach.

Marissa Cole
Privacy Program Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: art30-ledger-excerpt.pdf (stub)

From: Ben Wilkes <ben.w@auditfirm.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Claire Jacobs <c.jacobs@medicore.com>
Cc: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-31T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: DPIA evidence snapshot + limited on-site observation request

Thanks — quick clarifications from the auditor side before we confirm the slot: 

- SOC 2 type II or equivalent: can we get the most recent report (redacted if necessary)? It helps scope testing steps.
- KMS questions: need to confirm whether any cryptographic operations occur in a third country (e.g., key wrapping in an APAC region). If yes, please list regions per key ID.
- Subprocessors: please flag any analytics/telemetry vendors that could reconstruct identifiers — we’ll need a short privacy impact note for each.

Claire: based on your PO/contract reference MDCR-2026-011 we’ll plan the observation to cover ledger sampling, KMS wrap walkthrough, and subprocessor screening. If Redwood can provide the SOC 2 snapshot by EOD 2026-09-02 we can finalise our procedures.

Ben Wilkes
Principal, Third-Party Assurance — Atlas Audit Partners

Attachment: none

From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Jacobs <c.jacobs@medicore.com>, Ben Wilkes <ben.w@auditfirm.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-31T15:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: DPIA evidence snapshot + limited on-site observation request

All — final plan and commitments: 

Deliverables (by 2026-09-03 EOD PT):
- art30-ledger-excerpt.pdf (filtered to Medicore integration) — attached to portal
- processing-ledger-90d-sample.csv (n=2,500) — anonymised token strategy applied
- subprocessor-inventory.csv — includes region and role; redaction metadata where contract clauses prevent disclosure
- kms-wrap-summary.txt — includes key ownership model and region per key-id (no secret material)
- SOC 2 snapshot (redacted) — we will provide our latest SOC 2 Type II summary report (redacted PII/customer information)

Access & logistics:
- Secure portal: https://drive.redwood.com/s/shared/MED-2026-DPIA-PORTAL (provisioned 2026-09-01 to 2026-09-08)
- Portal controls: SSO + MFA required, IP restriction to Medicore auditor ranges, read-only downloads, audit log retained for 90 days.
- Observation: virtual session confirmed for 2026-09-08 10:00–12:00 PT — Irene will lead the walkthrough; Ben will have observer access. If Medicore still needs an on-site, we can discuss visitor NDA and escort requirements.

Next steps for Medicore: confirm the virtual slot and provide the auditor IPs for portal allowlist. Claire — once you confirm, Marissa and Tessa will upload the initial package and send access instructions.

Thanks everyone — we’ll aim to keep the evidence minimal and the controls demonstrable.

Nikhil Sharma
Senior Manager, Privacy & Compliance
Redwood Inference
